dialogue.text: Creidim go bhfuil teorainneacha, más féidir le do ráitis dochar a dhéanamh do dhuine eile.
dialogue.translation: I believe there are limits, if your words can harm someone else.

dialogue.text: Céard a thabharfá mar shampla?
dialogue.translation: What would you give as an example?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Má chuala tú cainteanna hate a thosaigh fadhbanna móra, is é sin teorainn.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ach cá háit a chur tú an teorainn sin?

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Cé a chinneann céard is dochar?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Is é an dlí a dhéanann sin, ach is deacair aon rialacha a chur i bhfeidhm.
dialogue.translation: The law does that, but it’s hard to enforce any rules.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tá tú chomh mór ar an gceart sin, ach cá fhad a théann sé?
